# Rosetta — Linux Command & Package Discovery

> People switching to Linux shouldn't have to dig through outdated forums.
> Search what you need → pick your distro → copy the command. Done.

## Core Features
- **Distro-Aware Commands**: Optimized install and uninstall commands for Arch, Ubuntu, Debian, Fedora, and more.
- **Categorized Discovery**: Browse by Development Tools, System Utilities, Text Editors, etc.
- **Side-by-side Comparison**: Compare package alternatives (e.g., nodejs vs. deno).
- **Quick Start Guides**: Step-by-step Markdown guides for post-install setups.
- **Global Search**: Command palette (Cmd+K) for instant package navigation.
- **Modern UI**: Dark mode, responsive design, and polished microinteractions.

## Technology Stack
- **Framework**: Next.js 16 (App Router + Turbopack)
- **Language**: TypeScript
- **Database**: MySQL with Drizzle ORM
- **Styling**: Tailwind CSS
- **Components**: Radix UI + Lucide Icons
- **CLI**: TUI companion for terminal-based discovery

## Sitemap Summary
- `/`: Homepage with popular categories and hero search.
- `/category/[slug]`: Package listings for specific categories.
- `/package/[slug]`: Detail page with distro-tabbed commands.
- `/distro/[slug]`: All supported packages for a specific distribution.
- `/tag/[slug]`: Filtered listings by tags (e.g., #cli, #gui).
- `/guide/[slug]`: Markdown-based educational content.
- `/compare?a=[slug]&b=[slug]`: Side-by-side comparison mode.
- `/admin`: Management dashboard for packages, guides, and settings.

## Contribution
Rosetta is community-driven. All commands are verified to ensure they work on the latest releases of supported distributions.
